stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Ciro and Enzo must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: B

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Ciro and Enzo must not occupy consecutive positions." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Ada → Bela → Dina → Ciro → Enzo
- Ada → Ciro → Enzo → Bela → Dina
- Bela → Dina → Ciro → Enzo → Ada
- Ciro → Enzo → Bela → Dina → Ada
